    },
    {
      "id": "c:6206213292",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Clarify and document the intended behavior around updating timestamps versus increasing multiplicity in AddSingle.",

      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "accepted author's explanation and agreed that dropping the update interval is the right approach",

      "status_by_id": "c:6932692065",
      "status_by_quote": "Concept ACK! Thanks for digging into how we ended up with `update_interval`, it's very interesting to read :)"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4358998250",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Add a test checking that a relayed newer announcement can still add buckets / bump multiplicity.",
      "quote": "Besides checking that relayed duplicates don’t add buckets, maybe we could also check that a relayed newer announcement still can.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added a unit test covering this in the latest push",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4601762776"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4601762776",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks, this is covered by the added unit test in the first commit."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5643014721",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "A relayed announcement more than an hour newer than the previous one can no longer add a bucket, keeping nodes that announce daily at multiplicity 1.",

      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author pushed a commit dropping the 1h rule to fix the issue",

        "r:5652371266",

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6952536079",
      "status_by_quote": "Addressed feedback and added a commit that drops the 1h rule, with a test for the nTime behavior."
